newsitem.title: CANADA: Xillix Technologies wins FDA approval.
newsitem.headline: Xillix Technologies wins FDA approval.

text.p: Xillix Technologies Corp said on Friday it has received final approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for its endoscopy system.
The company said the global market potential for the Life-Lung Fluorescence Endoscopy System will be about US$750 million, of which 35 percent is estimated to come from the U.S. market.
"The FDA approval is a monumental achievement for Xillix as we can now aggressively pursue our corporate objectives," Xillix president Pierre Leduc said in a statement.
Xillix said it had teamed up with Olympus Optical Co Ltd of Tokyo to handle worldwide marketing and distribution of the endoscopy system.
Olympus controls about 70 percent of the global market for endoscopic equipment and accessories, Xillix said.
The system uses a blue light source to activate the natural fluorescence of the lung tissue to detect cancer, the company said. No drugs are necessary for the method to work.
